Evan — thanks, this looks good. Thursday works for us. Quick clarifications from the Redwood side: 

- Goal: enable seamless trace propagation from LangChain -> LlamaIndex -> Redwood runtime traces so customers get end-to-end observability without modifying model prompts.
- Success criteria: spans appear with both model and prompt metadata, no more than 50ms extra p95 latency for traced requests at typical QPS.

Action items before kickoff (owner):
- Share sample trace payloads and headers we expect (Karthik)
- Validate model-server kernel hooks for span injection (Mateo)
- Red-team check for sensitive PII leaking into trace attributes (Marissa)

Can Karthik and Mateo join the kickoff? I think a short pre-read (the compatibility matrix) will help. Also please put the Drive link in the invite so we have the checklist in one place.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: LC/LlamaIndex tracer coupling — kickoff

Thanks for the agenda — a couple of tech notes from LlamaIndex before the meeting: 

- LlamaIndex has a pluggable tracer interface in v0.9.x and we maintain two adapters (opentelemetry and a lightweight JSON shim). The opentelemetry adapter preserves attributes but currently drops model-context fields unless explicitly whitelisted.
- We've sketched a small patch to carry model_context.{model_name,token_count,cache_hit} as span attributes; see attached tracer-api-compat-matrix.md for rows with "required" vs "optional" attributes.
- We recommend starting with a non-production canary using a subset of keys to validate privacy and size constraints.

I'll attach the matrix and a short patch diff. Happy to demo the adapter during the kickoff.

Attachments: tracer-api-compat-matrix.md

Best,
Priya Shah
Integration Lead, LlamaIndex (contractor)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@llindex.dev>, Evan Brooks <evan@tracebridge.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: LC/LlamaIndex tracer coupling — kickoff

Perfect — thanks Priya. Quick operational notes from our side ahead of the meeting: 

- Mateo and I validated the current runtime hook points; we can accept an opentelemetry-compatible span with attributes under the "redwood.model" prefix and forward it into our infra. We'll need to whitelist attributes to avoid unbounded cardinality.
- Proposed canary plan (high level): 
  1) Developer sandbox: instrument a single LangChain flow with LlamaIndex adapter, collect traces for 48 hours (owner: Mateo)
  2) Internal beta: route 1% of production traffic from a non-critical customer to the traced path for 7 days, validate latency and cardinality (owner: Karthik)
  3) Full rollout: stagger by customer tier, with automated rollback on trace volume or latency regressions (owner: Partnerships + Infra)

I've uploaded a short pre-checklist and an acceptance criteria doc to the shared Drive link. Evan/Vanessa — can Partnerships support the internal beta customer selection? Marissa — can you own the PII whitelist review?

I'll be on the kickoff; looking forward to the demo.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Engineer, Runtime Observability
